chapter: Recent years and early piano influences
title: Joe Turner as a kind mentor
summary: Turner encouraged him; Ramirez could not stride as well, with small hands.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Then later on, when I became a little bit more grown, I met Joe Turner. Joe Turner was an influence in my life, but I could never stride the way... I tried to copy everything that he did, you know. But he was so good and he was so kind to me. He was a real buddy when I was young. He was very encouraging. And as I began...
How much older would he be than you?
Well, he'd be... He celebrated what, his 77th birthday, 76th...
When you're young, five or six years makes a lot of difference, doesn't it.

Yeah. Some people spring up. I was more or less on the small side, the skinny side. I didn't grow too fast, you know. I remember in school I was watching the kids grow faster than me; I was wondering what's going to happen to me, you know, and that kind of thing. And then, of course, I became aware of my limitation; my hands were not as large as the other blessed fellows that could reach a tenth. You know, I couldn't reach a tenth on the keys if I played ..(?)..
